transport.title: Getting there
transport.hint: S-Bahn S8, S9 and regional trains
transport.text: The airport's regional station links it directly with Frankfurt, Offenbach, Hanau, Aschaffenburg, Rüsselsheim, Mainz and Wiesbaden: S-Bahn lines S8 and S9 and regional trains RB58, RE59, RE2 and RE3. The station is on the underground level of Terminal 1 (Level 0), reached from all areas A, B, C by following the “Train stations S T” signs. Trains arrive at platforms 1–3. To Terminal 3 — by the SkyLine train, about 10–15 minutes, following the “Terminal 3 G, H, J” signs.

taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.hint: Round the clock, 20–30 min to city
taxi.text: Taxis wait round the clock at all three terminals and at the long-distance train station. The trip from Frankfurt takes 20 to 30 minutes depending on traffic. Uber pick-up and drop-off: at Terminal 1 — short-term car park P31 (departures level); at Terminal 3 pick-up in coach lane P62, drop-off on departures level P63.

terminals.title: Terminals
terminals.text: Terminals 1 and 3 are linked by the free SkyLine train: it runs from 4:00 to 23:00 every 2–3 minutes, with stations in both terminals. From 22:00 to 5:00 a shuttle bus runs between the terminals; stops are in front of the terminal buildings, on the forecourt in front of arrivals.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.hint: Lufthansa in T1, SkyTeam in T3
lounges.text: In Terminal 1 after security — Lufthansa lounges (Business, Senator, First Class) in areas A, B and Z, the Lufthansa Bistro Lounge (Non-Schengen) in area C and the Air Canada Lounge in area B. In Terminal 3 after security — the Air France Lounge in area H, and the Emirates Lounge, Priority Lounge and SkyTeam Lounge in area J. Before security — the Luxx Lounge in Terminal 1, area C.

sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.text: napcabs sleeping cabins with a bed, air conditioning, alarm clock and desk — in Terminal 1 after security: 6 in Pier A Schengen and 3 in transit area B on Level 3 (escalator by gate B42); in Terminal 3 — 3 in Pier H Schengen and 5 in Pier J Non-Schengen. From 6:00 to 22:00 €17 per hour (minimum 2 hours), from 22:00 to 6:00 €12 per hour (minimum 3 hours). Online booking by card or PayPal, on site by card only. There are showers near the cabins.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: The airport has 15,000 parking spaces in total. Booked online, Terminal Parking costs from €99.00 for 7 days, Weekend Special (2–3 days, Friday to Sunday) from €55.00; booking is possible from 9 months to 24 hours before departure, for 1–44 days. Maximum entry height at the terminal car parks is 2.10 m; taller vehicles use coach park P36. Cars running on autogas (LPG) are not allowed in the Terminal 1 car parks but are allowed in the Terminal 3 car park.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free unlimited Wi‑Fi round the clock, more than 300 access points, no registration needed. Choose the “Airport-Frankfurt” network, then Wi-Fi Free or Wi-Fi Free+, and tap “Go online”, accepting the terms of Fraport AG.
